warning: Hand-written examples, NOT captures. They exist to fix the shape of the hub contract (POST /api/ingest/solana) and to document name mismatches. Nothing here has been posted to the hub.

onchainSamples.comment: Shape of a real ARES-1 on-chain event as the exporter normalizes it. Coordinates are the exporter/DB identity; they are NOT private data.
onchainSamples.note: u64 fields are decimal strings by design; the hub must read them as strings or BigInt, never as JS floats.

onchainSamples.comment: First-gameplay-action candidate for the hub funnel, if the hub accepts a game-specific event: create_field emits FieldCreated and burns 100/250/500 POTATO.
onchainSamples.note: The hub funnel today recognizes MatchStarted/RaceStarted/PlotCreated/PotatoPlanted/PackOpened, not AssetCreated/FieldCreated. Mapping must be agreed before this can drive a funnel.

onchainSamples.comment: Purchase rail where the currency is only knowable from the emitting instruction. Without instruction context the resource stays null - never guess SKR vs SOL.
onchainSamples.resourceResolution: instructionName == buy_field_skr -> SKR atoms; buy_field_sol -> lamports; anything else -> null
onchainSamples.note: amount is a raw integer in the currency of the emitting instruction (here 1053.000000 SKR). It is not USD and must not be converted by the hub.

adapterNameMismatchSamples.comment: These are the names the current hub adapter expects for ares1. They are NOT emitted by the deployed program. They are listed only so the mapping gap is unambiguous.

offchainSample.comment: Illustrates why the hub's offchainIdentity() cannot be satisfied by ARES-1 today. The real backend has these facts in PostgreSQL but emits nothing.
offchainSample.reason: No emitter exists, no eventId/sessionId/seq exist, and the hub's offchain identity contract requires provider + campaignId/pageId/sessionId/seq. Do not send until the contract and privacy basis are agreed.
privateFieldsNeverToExport: any token, HMAC secret or credential
